evaluations.claim: StrmLLM (n=64) (blue) ultimately plateaus at roughly 2.75, consistently exceeding the loss of all other configurations beyond 40,000 iterations.
evaluations.reality: StrmLLM (n=64) (blue) actually plateaus near 2.6, not 2.75, and does not consistently exceed the loss of all other configurations; it remains above SepLLM variants but below Vanilla after 40,000 iterations.

evaluations.claim: SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red) stabilizes prematurely, maintaining a loss of approximately 2.65 after 60,000 iterations, indicating diminished optimization efficiency.
evaluations.reality: SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red) does not stabilize at 2.65; it continues to decline and ends near 2.49, with no evidence of premature stabilization or diminished efficiency.

evaluations.claim: SepLLM (n=64) (orange) initially declines at a marginally slower rate than SepLLM (n=64, H) (green).
evaluations.reality: SepLLM (n=64) (orange) and SepLLM (n=64, H) (green) decline at nearly identical rates initially, with no discernible difference in the rate of loss reduction.
evaluations.reason: Initial decline rates are described as similar.
